caption: LUM-1336 CJK composer: a draft of wide (2-cell) glyphs has to wrap at the terminal's *column* budget, not at one column per character. Pre-fix the composer measured every character as one cell, so a 45-glyph CJK draft was laid out as one 45-cell row while the terminal draws it as 90 columns: the tail fell past the composer's right edge, and because ratatui's diff skips the cell after each wide symbol the row also kept stale placeholder cells (`世界` rendered as `世p`).

probe.why: 40 columns of ASCII fit the 58-column composer body

probe.why: the row is exactly label + the two glyphs
pre-fix the diff skipped the cell after each wide symbol and the placeholder's `p` survived
